The '''Ragoon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Ragoon system was surrounded by several [[Star/Legends|stars]]. This system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ragoon VI]], which was under the jurisdiction of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] with the help of [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Aaeton]]. The people of Ragoon transferred their power to the Senate to ensure the wonders of their world were never be destroyed. In space, the planet of Ragoon VI gave off a blue glow.
